validation_scope: Full GNU/musl debug/release suites: 2,095 tests each; strict Clippy for GNU, musl, and, type-checking without linking, macOS arm64 and Windows x86_64; formatting, the coverage, mutation, performance, and release helper checks, and the editor packages; actionlint with shellcheck on both workflows; cargo publish --dry-run; 11 sensitivity probes, all caught; a rehearsal dry run and a final dry run on main, each building all three platforms.
review_notes: GitHub dispatches a workflow by hand only once it is on the default branch, so the first runs were a rehearsal: a branch push with a temporary trigger, removed before merging. The first rehearsal never started: one-line notice steps held ': ' and were not valid YAML. CI now runs actionlint on every workflow so that such a file cannot reach a tag.
The release workflow calls CI first. CI's concurrency group now includes the calling workflow's name, so a dry run on main and main's own CI do not cancel each other.

The crate had grown to 5.5 MiB compressed, mostly evidence records under docs/; it now excludes them and packages at 1.6 MiB. Cargo.toml's homepage and repository moved from github.com/nitimis/botwork, which redirects, to github.com/dhilipsiva/botwork. The yanked yoke-derive 0.8.3 in both lockfiles moved to 0.8.4.

ovsx joined the VS Code extension's locked development dependencies, which do not ship in the extension, so Open VSX publishing uses the official client at a pinned version. wingetcreate is downloaded at a pinned version and checked against its published SHA-256, as CI already does for Helix.

Main's own CI at the merged commit failed one Windows debug test, a_runtime_without_time_reports_a_typed_configuration_failure, unrelated to this item: its one-second deadline expired while the caught panic printed its backtrace, so the deadline became the primary error, as designed. The test now uses a deadline it cannot reach. The dry run's call to CI at the same commit passed every job.
The Scoop and Homebrew jobs need a token that can push to the bucket or tap, as well as the repository's name; the owner prerequisites now list both.
limits: Publishing itself has not run: it needs a version tag and the owner's credentials. The dry runs exercise every step up to it, and the GitHub release step only on a tag.
Build provenance is attested only when publishing, so the dry runs do not produce attestations.
The winget package identifier is dhilipsiva.Botwork; the owner can change WINGET_IDENTIFIER in scripts/release.py before the first submission.

"""Sensitivity probes for scripts/release.py: each plants one defect in a copy
of the repository's release files and requires tests/release_tools.py to fail."""
import json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path("/home/dhilipsiva/projects/dhilipsiva/botwork")
FILES = ["scripts/release.py", "tests/release_tools.py", ".github/workflows/release.yml", ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
         "Cargo.toml", "editors/vscode/package.json", "LICENSE", "README.md"]
PROBES = [
    ("any-tag-publishes", "scripts/release.py", '    if tag != f"v{cargo}":\n', '    if False:\n'),
    ("extension-version-ignored", "scripts/release.py", "    if extension != cargo:\n", "    if False:\n"),
    ("archive-time-not-fixed", "scripts/release.py", "                info.size, info.mode, info.mtime = len(data), mode, moment\n", "                info.size, info.mode, info.mtime = len(data), mode, time.time()\n"),
    ("binary-not-executable", "scripts/release.py", '        (executable, Path(binary).read_bytes(), 0o755),\n', '        (executable, Path(binary).read_bytes(), 0o644),\n'),
    ("checksums-cover-themselves", "scripts/release.py", ' and path.name != "SHA256SUMS")', ')'),
    ("altered-archive-accepted", "scripts/release.py", '        if sha256(Path(directory) / name) != sums[name]:\n', '        if False:\n'),
    ("winget-hash-lowercase", "scripts/release.py", "InstallerSha256: {windows_hash.upper()}", "InstallerSha256: {windows_hash}"),
    ("tap-gets-the-linux-archive-for-mac", "scripts/release.py", '    mac_url, mac_hash = asset("aarch64-apple-darwin")\n', '    mac_url, mac_hash = asset("x86_64-unknown-linux-musl")\n'),
    ("unpinned-action", ".github/workflows/release.yml", "uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2", "uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v4"),
    ("publishing-without-a-tag", ".github/workflows/release.yml", "        if: env.PUBLISH == 'true' && env.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN != ''\n", "        if: env.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN != ''\n"),
    ("silent-skip", ".github/workflows/release.yml", "winget skipped: WINGET_TOKEN is not set", "winget skipped"),
]
results = {}
baseline = None
for name, path, before, after in [("baseline", None, None, None), *PROBES]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        copy = Path(directory)
        for file in FILES:
            (copy / file).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(ROOT / file, copy / file)
        if path:
            text = (copy / path).read_text()
            assert text.count(before) == 1, name
            (copy / path).write_text(text.replace(before, after))
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/release_tools.py"], cwd=copy, capture_output=True, text=True)
        failed = [line for line in run.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(("FAIL:", "ERROR:"))]
        results[name] = {"returncode": run.returncode, "failures": failed}
        print(name, run.returncode, failed[:2], flush=True)
assert results["baseline"]["returncode"] == 0
assert all(result["returncode"] != 0 and result["failures"] for name, result in results.items() if name != "baseline"), "a probe survived"
out = ROOT / "target" / "release-probes.json"
out.write_text(json.dumps({"probes": [dict(zip(("id", "file", "before", "after"), probe)) for probe in PROBES], "results": results}, indent=2) + "\n")
print("all probes caught; record:", out)

"""Record a release workflow run: its jobs and notices, and independent checks
of what it produced. The assets' checksums are verified, the packaged Linux
binary is run, and every archive is rebuilt here from the binary it holds, at
the tagged commit's timestamp, and compared byte for byte."""
import hashlib, json, os, runpy, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path("/home/dhilipsiva/projects/dhilipsiva/botwork")
run, out = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
RELEASE = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "scripts/release.py"))
view = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["gh", "run", "view", run, "--json", "jobs,headSha,headBranch,conclusion,event,workflowName"], text=True))
record = {"run": run, "url": f"https://github.com/dhilipsiva/botwork/actions/runs/{run}", "workflow": view["workflowName"], "event": view["event"],
          "head_sha": view["headSha"], "branch": view["headBranch"], "conclusion": view["conclusion"], "jobs": {}, "notices": []}
for job in view["jobs"]:
    record["jobs"][job["name"]] = job["conclusion"]
    for annotation in json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["gh", "api", f"repos/dhilipsiva/botwork/check-runs/{job['databaseId']}/annotations"], text=True)):
        if annotation["annotation_level"] == "notice" and "skipped" in annotation["message"]:
            record["notices"].append({"job": job["name"], "message": annotation["message"]})
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    work = Path(directory)
    for name in ("release", "manifests"):
        subprocess.run(["gh", "run", "download", run, "--name", name, "--dir", str(work / name)], check=True)
    assets = work / "release"
    check = subprocess.run(["sha256sum", "--check", "--strict", "SHA256SUMS"], cwd=assets, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record["checksums"] = {"returncode": check.returncode, "output": check.stdout.splitlines(), "SHA256SUMS": (assets / "SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines()}
    version = RELEASE["versions"]()[0]
    epoch = subprocess.check_output(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%ct", view["headSha"]], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
    project = work / "project"
    project.mkdir()
    for name in ("LICENSE", "README.md"):
        (project / name).write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{view['headSha']}:{name}"], cwd=ROOT))
    record["reproduced"] = {}
    for target in RELEASE["TARGETS"]:
        archive = assets / RELEASE["archive_name"](version, target)
        unpacked = work / "unpacked" / target
        unpacked.mkdir(parents=True)
        if archive.suffix == ".zip":
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as opened:
                names = opened.namelist()
                opened.extractall(unpacked)
        else:
            with tarfile.open(archive) as opened:
                names = opened.getnames()
                opened.extractall(unpacked, filter="data")
        binary = unpacked / names[0]
        os.environ["SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"] = epoch
        again = RELEASE["package"](version, target, binary, work / "again", project)
        record["reproduced"][target] = {"entries": names, "identical": again.read_bytes() == archive.read_bytes(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        if target == "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl":
            record["linux_binary"] = {"version": subprocess.check_output([str(binary), "--version"], text=True).strip(),
                                      "file": subprocess.check_output(["file", "--brief", str(binary)], text=True).strip()}
    record["manifests"] = sorted(str(path.relative_to(work / "manifests")) for path in (work / "manifests").rglob("*") if path.is_file())
out.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in record.items() if key not in ("jobs",)}, indent=1)[:3000])

assert len(full) == 4 and len(totals) == 1
